club.fee_allocation_tip:
Fee Allocation explanation:

If player A, B, C put 40 chips, 40 chips, 20 chips into the pot, the total pot is 100 chips. A is the winner, B and C are the losers. The whole pot (player A, B, C) got into the pot divide the total pot to 40%, 40%, 20%, fee is 5% of the pot. So the total fee is 5 chips.

1. If you set fee allocation as 0%, the fee will be distributed between players according to how many chips they put into the pot, so the fee counted to each player is:
Player A: 5×40% = 2
Player B: 5×40% = 2
Player C: 5×20% = 1

2. If you set fee allocation as 60%, 60% of the total fee will only be distributed between losers, the rest 40% of the total fee will be distributed between winners and losers according to how many chips they put into the pot.
club.hint:
The pot must be equal or bigger than 10BBs. At least 4 
players must be dealt in preflop. In case of running it
 multi times, only the first runout counts.
The Blinds in the chart correspond to the Ante in 6+.
club.hint_2:
Tips:
1. Losing players must have a minimum qualifying hand. Both players must use two cards from their hand.
2. In NLH, Full house must lose to Quads or above, and the player holding Full house must have at least one Ace in his hole card.
3. In Flash table, if you switch to another table in advance before this hand ends, you will not receive the Jackpot Share reward of this hand.

club.level_tip:
Agents can be assigned as sub-agents to the super agents, and clubs can manage more agents through Super Agent function.

Please note,

After assigning an agent as a sub-agent to a super agent, the data of the sub-agent will be continuously counted and added to the data of the super agent. Before assigning the sub-agent to the super agent, please pay attention to the data of the sub-agent to avoid double counting.

club.rule_text:
1. Only LV1 clubs or above can create or join a Union.
2. After creating or joining a Union, chips retained in your club will still be available in that particular Union. However, chips held by the agents and players will be removed.
3. After creating or joining a Union, players' total number of hands played and the fee will be recalculated.
4. After leaving the Union, original club data prior to joining the Union will be restored.
Rejoining Union will restore Union data.
5. Union chips will not be available in the original club after leaving the Union.
Rejoining Union will restore the chips held by the Club in the Union. However, chips exchanged out of the Union cannot be brought into the Union.
6. Currently, one club can only be part of one union.
